description:
Your heart works all day, so why does flexing your bicep burn? Cyto breaks it down from the 6ix, riding the #BicepHeart trend.

Three reasons. One: according to a 2024 review in Circulation Research, mitochondria (the cell's power plants) make up about one third of a heart muscle cell, and the heart gets about 95% of its energy from them, using oxygen. Two: the heart does rest. It relaxes between every beat, and in healthy hearts that relaxed phase is the bigger share of each cycle. Three: your bicep is built for bursts. Hold a hard flex and metabolites from the working muscle build up; in a human study, a mix of those metabolites was enough to produce the feeling of fatigue and ache.

The trend itself is just a pose: flex one arm and press the other hand on the inside of the bicep so it makes a heart shape. No health claim, just a good excuse to talk about muscle.

Not medical advice. Chest pain or an unusual heartbeat? Talk to your doctor or call emergency services.
